newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE to revise margin rules on futures and options.
newsitem.headline: TSE to revise margin rules on futures and options.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Wednesday it plans to require its members to calculate and deposit margins for customer accounts and their own accounts separately starting from October.
The new rule will apply to Japanese government bond (JGB) futures, options on JGB futures, stock index futures and options traded on the exchange.

The current rule, which allows exchange members to calculate the required margins after netting their customers' and own accounts, has been criticised as risky because if a member broker defaults its customer might not be able to collect the deposited margin.
The TSE also said the method of calculating customer margins will be changed in October from the current gross method to a net method.
Currently, a customer margin is calculated based on a gross of long and short positions. Under the new method, the deposit will be required for the difference between long and short positions.
